en.summary: OKX's Anthropic IPO Carnival has 250,000 USDT in rewards: 200,000 USDT for a trading competition on Anthropic pre-IPO perps and 50,000 USDT for Outcomes events, where you make predictions with free XP. It is open only to users in eligible regions; the announcement does not state the most one person can get or the campaign dates.
steps: Log in to OKX (or sign up) and open the Anthropic IPO Carnival campaign page. Check that it is available in your region: the announcement only says “eligible regions only” and does not list the countries.

Read the full terms on the campaign page and tap Join / Register if there is such a button. The announcement does not say whether separate event registration, KYC (identity verification) or a minimum amount is required.
Trading competition: trade Anthropic pre-IPO perps to compete for a share of 200,000 USDT. The minimum trading volume, how winners are ranked and the deadline are not stated in the announcement.

Outcomes: use free XP to make your call on what happens next with the Anthropic IPO, for a share of 50,000 USDT. The announcement does not say how much XP you start with or until when you can make predictions.
Optional, to earn more XP: share your take with the hashtag #AnthropicIPOUpdates. The announcement does not say which platform to post on or how much XP one post earns.

payout.when: Not stated. The announcement gives no start or end date, no payout date and no claim deadline. Check the full terms on the campaign page before you begin.
payout.form: Rewards are in USDT: 200,000 USDT for the pre-IPO perps trading competition and 50,000 USDT for Outcomes (250,000 USDT in total). You get a “share” of a pool, not a fixed amount; there is no reward table and no per-person maximum in the announcement. The rules do not say whether this is withdrawable USDT or a bonus/voucher (for example, one that can only cover fees or margin) — check the reward details on OKX before counting on cash. XP is described only as points you use in Outcomes; nothing says it can be converted into money.
payout.how: Not stated. The announcement does not say where the reward will show up (for example, the Rewards Center or your Funding account) or whether you have to claim it manually. Watch the campaign page and your OKX notifications after the event.

watch: Eligible regions only. The country list is not in the announcement — check whether the campaign is available in your country (including Ukraine) on the campaign page while logged in. Do not try to get around this with a VPN or someone else's account: that breaks the terms.
The rules are incomplete: only the announcement preview was available. The full terms and conditions may add minimums, exclusions and disqualification rules — read them before you trade.

Perps (perpetual futures) are contracts on a price with no expiry date, not the asset itself. They are usually traded with leverage, so a small price move can wipe out your margin (liquidation). Taking part in the competition can cost you more than you win.
You pay trading fees (and on perps usually funding fees — a periodic payment between long and short traders) whether or not you win anything.
The announcement does not explain what happens to Anthropic pre-IPO perps if the IPO happens, is delayed or is cancelled. Check the contract specifications before opening a position.
The reward is a share of a fixed pool, not a guaranteed amount. How the 200,000 USDT is split (by volume, profit or ranking) is not stated.
Beware of fakes: OKX itself asks you to check the authenticity of all OKX links and channels via OKX channel verification. Open the campaign only from the official OKX app or website.

faq.a: The announcement only says “eligible regions only” and that the campaign may not be available in all regions; there is no country list. Open the campaign page in the OKX app while logged in and check whether you can join. Do not use a VPN to get around the restriction.

faq.q: Do I have to spend my own money?
faq.a: According to the announcement, Outcomes uses free XP, so that part does not need your funds. The trading competition requires trading pre-IPO perps, which means using your own money as margin and paying fees.

They are perpetual futures contracts on the expected price of a company that has not listed on a stock exchange yet. You do not buy Anthropic shares; you only gain or lose on changes in the contract price. The price can swing a lot.

faq.q: How will the 200,000 USDT be split between traders?
faq.a: Not stated. The announcement only says “a share of 200,000 USDT”. Whether winners are decided by volume, profit or ranking should be in the full terms on the campaign page.

faq.q: What is XP and how do I get it?
faq.a: XP are points you spend in Outcomes to make predictions. The announcement says some XP is free and you can earn more by sharing your take with #AnthropicIPOUpdates. It does not say how much XP you get or whether XP has any value outside Outcomes.

faq.q: When does the campaign start and end?
faq.a: The announcement gives no dates. Check them on the OKX campaign page so you don't miss the deadline.

faq.q: Am I guaranteed to win something?
faq.a: No. Participants compete for a share of a pool, and the announcement gives neither a guaranteed amount nor a per-person maximum. You can spend money on fees and receive nothing.

faq.q: Where can I read the full rules?
faq.a: The announcement says the campaign is subject to terms and conditions; they should be on the OKX campaign page. Open it only from the official app or website and verify links via OKX channel verification.
